global: sleigh bells, glockenspiel, celesta, pizzicato strings, bouncy tuba, light drums

sections.name: hook
sections.style: a sparkly Christmas fanfare that deflates into a sad wobbly tuba and a comic record-scratch-like stop, disappointed and funny

sections.name: dream
sections.style: lush magical Christmas wonderland: sleigh bells, soaring celesta and glockenspiel, warm strings, twinkling and over-the-top perfect

sections.name: promise
sections.style: bouncy optimistic sales-pitch march with sleigh bells, building and counting up, cheeky brass stabs

sections.name: count
sections.style: sparse and empty: a lonely plucked melody, five slow pizzicato notes, echoing, deflated

sections.name: drips
sections.style: deadpan comic: plinking glockenspiel drip notes over a slow sad bassoon

sections.name: reveal
sections.style: mysterious hush then a glitchy digital sparkle reveal, synth arpeggio wobble, sneaky

sections.name: cancel
sections.style: comic collapse: three heavy brass hits in a row then a sad trombone slide

sections.name: lesson
sections.style: dry shrug: sleepy tuba and pizzicato, a sigh, gentle and deadpan

sections.name: ending
sections.style: cheeky warm Christmas outro with sleigh bells and glockenspiel melody, playful button ending
